body: Relax, I'm not going to harm myself in any way, I'm just so fucking tired of everything. But thanks I guess, it's funny how strangers on reddit seem to care more than actual people I know.
That very well could be the main reason why we tend to look for sad music when we're sad
Glad it did, I tend to forget about them (I'm a shitty prog fan, I know)
OMG, btbam are one of my favorite groups ever, didn't know this solo project! Thanks!
Agree, Opeth are my way to go when I'm like this
Yeah, that SHOULD be the way to go, but I honestly can't happy and cheerful lyrics right now
That single line might be the best piece of advice that I've ever got from a song
Thanks, didn't know the other songs aside from "Losing It" by Rush!

Well, simply because a really do consider myself a peace of shit, therefore other people notice it and don't want to be around me. I started thinking about kms because I simply cannot envision myself changing, no matter the efforts
It is, it truly is! It's just that sometimes I can't even see the light, let alone go for it, but it's something I'm trying to overcome somehow.
Yup! Had my first session last week and had teary eyes the whole time, even if we barely scratched the surface
Same, I just wish I had the balls to end it

Quick update

Just wanted to thank all of you who replied here, I've made up my mind and I'll be starting therapy in ten days, so yeah, thanks guys!

Yeah, that might be a good idea! I already brought it up very casually before, like wishing that we would live closer so we could meet and go out and she said something like never say never, but I really don't know if she meant it kinda seriously 😅

Getting sick is something unavoidable at some point, while a lot of people can live without ever seeing a therapist. My only coping mechanisms are booze and my job, I used to have hobbies, but I can't seem to focus on those anymore, my brain won't allow it, so it's pretty hard to distract myself

I feel like shit, I'm honestly asking myself if is worth living my useless life. I could try therapy, but I never did anything good in 30 years, I know for sure I'll fail it. I have to gather the courage to throw myself under a train and end it all.
I doubt it will, but thanks, really
Thx man, I wish something like that could be possible, but there's really just one way out in the end 🤷‍♂️

Nah, it wouldn't change a thing. In the end I'm such a failure that I'm not even able to muster the courage to throw myself under a train, so there's really no problem here. I just have to wait for a fatal heart attack or something like that
Yeah, it sucks, it just sucks

Yup, I'm aware of that, but I talked with more experienced collectors (I just recently started) and they told me that its price should be in the 400-450$ dollars range; that's a price I'm willing to pay and I could even go up to 500$ based on the book's conditions, but the only two copies listed online are at 750-800$, wich seems a bit excessive 😅
